about: Patrols around one of your holdings, shelters from armies too strong for it, strikes weaker enemies in the area and breaks weak sieges.
calls_back: a large army enters the area, a strong force besieges the holding, the holding falls, or the lord's ranks fall below the floor

radius: how far around the holding it watches, in map units
shelter_at: shelter when the enemies in the area are this many times its strength
strike_below: attack an enemy in the area, or the besiegers, up to this share of its strength
floor: shelter when its ranks fall below this share of full

when.poke: {me}'s ranks fell to {round(ranks * 100)}% near {at}; sheltering in {refuge}.
{me} is breaking the siege of {at}: strength {strength} against {siege_strength(at)}.
A strong force besieges {at}: strength {siege_strength(at)} against {me}'s {strength}. {me} is sheltering in {refuge}.
Enemies too strong for {me} are near {at}: strength {enemy_strength_near(at, radius)} against {strength}. {me} is sheltering in {refuge}.

when.if: weakest_enemy_near(at, radius) != none and strength_of(weakest_enemy_near(at, radius)) <= strength * strike_below
hours_in_state >= 3 and not besieged(at) and enemy_strength_near(at, radius) < strength * shelter_at * 0.8 and ranks >= floor

when.poke: The besiegers of {at} grew too strong to strike; {me} is sheltering in {refuge}.
